name: Mokolo

queries.query: Mokolo Cameroon official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified MINDCAF as the ministry responsible for cadastral plans and land administration. The official MINHDU SIG-WEB viewer was found as a public geospatial map, but no parcel service, schema, or safe native-ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.

queries.query: Mokolo Cameroun cadastre carte parcelles registre foncier officiel
queries.result: La recherche officielle a confirmé le rôle du MINDCAF dans l'élaboration et la tenue des plans cadastraux. Le SIG-WEB public du MINHDU a été identifié, mais aucune couche parcellaire publique, structure de données, CRS ou réponse anonyme sûre avec identifiant natif et géométrie n'a été qualifiée.

registryCustodian.name: Ministère des Domaines, du Cadastre et des Affaires Foncières (MINDCAF)
registryCustodian.scope: National cadastral and land-administration custodian; official mission page states responsibility for preparing and maintaining cadastral plans. No Mokolo-local public parcel endpoint was evidenced.

service.name: MINHDU SIG-WEB public viewer; parcel service not qualified
service.viewerConfiguration: Search result exposes a public JavaScript-dependent geospatial viewer with region, department and commune filters and urban themes. Direct retrieval of the current viewer HTML/configuration timed out; no service endpoint or parcel schema was retained.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: The public viewer did not return current HTML/configuration within the bounded request. This is an access limit, not evidence of a citywide parcel absence. No TLS bypass was used.
Official MINDCAF mission evidence identifies preparation and maintenance of cadastral plans as a ministry responsibility; it does not expose a Mokolo parcel API or parcel geometry.
French official mission evidence confirms the same national cadastral mandate; no local service or safe parcel response was exposed.
Official regional land-and-state-property document mentions Mokolo in Mayo-Tsanaga and describes national land-law context, but is not a parcel dataset or viewer.
